summary: Inserts byte-buffer node a2 into a doubly-linked list. When bit 4 of a2's first byte is set the head pointer is loaded from *(*this + 0x128), otherwise from *a2. If the list is already initialized (this[0xF4] non-null) it walks the next-pointer chain at offset 0x6C to the tail and appends a2; otherwise it stores the head in this[0xF4] and initializes a2's prev (0x68) and next (0x6C) to 0. Returns the head node pointer.

operations.description: Select the head pointer source: if bit 4 of a2's first byte is set, use the pointer at *(*this + 0x128); otherwise use *a2.
Load result = *v2, the first/head node pointer of the chain.
Branch on the list-init flag at this[0xF4]: non-null means the list already holds at least one node.
Walk the next-pointer chain at offset 0x6C from the head node until a null link is found, leaving result at the tail node.
Append: write a2 into the tail's next field at offset 0x6C, set a2's prev (offset 0x68) to the tail, and clear a2's next (offset 0x6C).
First insertion: store the head node into this[0xF4] and clear a2's prev (0x68) and next (0x6C).
